title: Filming the Speed of Light at 10 Trillion FPS
summary: The Slow Mo Guys visit a lab with a camera capable of filming at 10 trillion frames per second, fast enough to see light travel. They show the setup and the resulting footage.
why: Used as the standard reference whenever HN discusses filming light or ultrafast cameras.

quote.text: The slow mo guys did a video [1] at 10 trillion FPS.
